summary.en: One unit of a run as an object: a rounded box with a mono label whose outline wears one of four meanings: untouched, acted on now, learned, unseen.
summary.zh: 运行里的一个单元：带等宽标签的圆角块，描边只有四种含义：未动、正在处理、学到的、没见过。

fits: Any diagram whose units are counted, merged or tested.
notFor: Free-form labels (it is a unit of data, not a tag); more than four meanings.

intent.en: A unit of data looks like a thing that can be merged, counted or tested, and its outline says what is happening to it.
intent.zh: 一个数据单元看起来是能被合并、计数、测试的东西，轮廓颜色说明它正在经历什么。

content.zh: 一个代码标签（≤ 8 字符）。

fits.zh: 单元被计数、合并或测试的任何图解。

notFor.zh: 随意的标签（它是数据单元不是标签）；超过四种含义。

en: Four meanings at most; a fifth colour has no place in the legend.
zh: 最多四种含义；第五种颜色在图例里没位置。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
